referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Roofing Coats Chicago contractor homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a white and pale-blue split opening pairs service text and two bordered actions with a house-roof construction illustration. It uses compact white logo row with blue estimate control. The visual system relies on bold straightforward sans headings and compact service copy; surfaces include white, pale blue, royal blue, medium gray and accents include yellow, royal blue. Imagery is roof-frame illustration, workers installing material, and service close-ups. The page then runs through estimate navigation, split construction hero, blue appointment and hours strip, local roofing explanation, repair photo chapter, six-service grid, request callback form, customer review strip, emergency close and footer. Its service presentation is simple multi-row service cells for installation, repair, replacement, snow removal, gutters, and siding. Mobile changes to stack opening illustration after copy, keep emergency call and estimate adjacent, and make the request form readable. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy roof illustrations, contractor photographs, license claims, emergency hours, testimonials, phone numbers, or exact blue-and-yellow brand treatment.
